pullRequest.title: bun_core: StringBuilder views accept a zero-capacity buffer
pullRequest.body:
### Problem

- An assert-enabled build (debug, ASAN) aborts with `panic: assertion failed: self.cap > 0` in `StringBuilder::writable()`. `bun install` reaches it with a hosted-git shortcut that ends at the colon, like `"overrides": { "zz": "github:" }`.
- `allocate()` stores a pointer also for a count of 0 bytes. `writable()` and `allocated_slice()` (`src/bun_core/string/StringBuilder.rs:201-226`) asserted `cap > 0` for each builder with a pointer.

### Fix

- `writable()` asserts `len <= cap`, the precondition of its pointer arithmetic. This removes the abort.
- `allocated_slice()` loses the same assert. The Postgres call site drops its #22558 guard and reads `written_slice()`. No path on main fails there.
- Verified: `test/cli/install/hosted-git-info/`. On a debug build of main, 5 install tests and the guard of 13 parser rows fail (timeouts). All 18 pass with the fix. Two unit tests cover both views (Miri).
- Self-reviewed: 2 concerns raised, 2 addressed.

### Background

- `StringBuilder` counts each slice, allocates one buffer, then appends into it.
- `HostedGitInfo` mirrors npm's hosted-git-info. Both return `project: ""` for `github:`. The tests record that output, not a new contract.
- Considered a guard in `HostedGitInfo::copy_from`. It adds a release branch and leaves the assert false. Bake `computeChunks` (#20998) and Postgres `ErrorResponse` (#22558) hit it before.

### Downsides

- Assert-enabled builds lose the `cap > 0` check. A builder that counted nothing and appends bytes still panics on the bounds check.
- Release: 0 bytes changed in 4 `StringBuilder` symbols and 3 callers. Only `error_response_jsc::to_js` changes: 4412 -> 4400 B.

<details><summary>Notes</summary>

**Origin.** A fuzzer found the abort on an assert-enabled build. No issue exists. Only linux x64 was run.

**Proof runs (debug build).**

- Source of main (a4f1429148): 5 of 5 new install tests fail. The `beforeAll` hook of the 13 parser rows fails too, so these rows do not run. Each failure shows `timed out after 5000ms`, not an assertion diff. The child that aborts needs 5 s or more to print its stack trace. The late output has `panic: assertion failed: self.cap > 0`.
- This PR: 18 of 18 pass.
- The new tests pass on a release build of main, because a release build has no assert. `USE_SYSTEM_BUN=1` cannot show the failure.
- `test/regression/issue/postgres-stringbuilder-assertion-aggressive.test.ts` passes on main and on this PR. It does not tell the two apart.
- No caller reaches `allocated_slice()` with a zero-capacity buffer now. The Postgres call site was the one caller that could, and it reads `written_slice()`. `allocated_slice()` makes a slice over the whole capacity, and only the first `len` bytes are written.
- Two unit tests in `StringBuilder.rs` take an empty builder through `writable()`, `allocated_slice()`, `append()`, `written_slice()` and `move_to_slice()`. `cargo miri test -p bun_core --lib string_builder` runs them: 2 pass. With one of the old asserts back, 2 fail. CI does not run them. `cargo test -p bun_core` does not link, and the Miri job does not list `bun_core`, because other tests of that crate call foreign functions.

**Measurements.** Release builds of main (a4f1429148) and of this PR, same toolchain.

- release code, 4 StringBuilder symbols and 3 inlining callers: 0 bytes changed, 0 instructions differ (objdump). The symbols are `StringBuilder::allocate`, `append`, `append_count`, `add_concat`, `HostedGitInfo::from_url`, `HTTPClient::clone_metadata` and `bun_picohttp::Response::clone`.
- release .text: +0 B (readelf, 58,143,477 B on main and on the PR). `error_response_jsc::to_js`: 4412 -> 4400 B. It is the only one of 78,610 text symbols that changes size.
- from_url instructions per call (`github:user/repo#main`): 2596 -> 2596 (gdb `stepi` count over the call, JIT off). valgrind is not installed in the container.
- allocator calls per from_url call: malloc 7, zalloc 1, realloc 0, free 7 on PR (main: 7, 1, 0, 7).
- syscalls, `bun install` on the override fixture: file 67 -> 67, read 18 -> 18, write 3 -> 3, network 0 -> 0 (gdb `catch syscall`). strace is not installed in the container.
- assert-enabled checks per view call: `allocated_slice` 1 -> 0, `writable` 1 -> 1.
- `len <= cap` in `writable()`: 0 assertion failures in 8 existing test files on the debug build. The files are the three in `test/cli/install/hosted-git-info/`, `test/cli/install/overrides.test.ts`, `test/bundler/bundler_compile.test.ts`, `test/js/web/fetch/fetch.test.ts`, `test/js/bun/spawn/spawn.test.ts` and the Postgres test above. `fetch.test.ts` has the same 25 failures on main and on the PR. On the PR run, 2 more tests of `bundler_compile.test.ts` and 4 more tests of `spawn.test.ts` reached the 5000 ms timeout. All 6 pass with a longer timeout. The host had a load average above 250 during the runs.

**Callers.** `bun_core::StringBuilder` has 27 construction sites in 18 files: 19 direct and 8 through `HeaderBuilder::default()`. `writable()` has 10 callers outside the builder. Each one indexes the returned slice with bounds checks and adds to `len` only what it wrote. So `len <= cap` holds for them.

**Sites left as they are.**

- `src/runtime/valkey_jsc/js_valkey.rs:657-675` and `src/bundler/linker_context/computeChunks.rs:551-555` skip the builder when there is nothing to build. They also skip work, so they stay.
- Open PR #43942 sizes a buffer above the exact sum because of this assert. It can use the exact sum after this PR.

**Tests.**

- The install tests are in `hosted-git-info/boundary-conditions.test.ts`, not in `overrides.test.ts`. That file installs from the public npm registry, and these tests are about the spec parser.
- The `dependency github:` test records what release bun does for that spec today. It sends one `GET /repos//tarball/` and exits with code 1. The test uses a local server through `GITHUB_API_URL`.
- The expected objects in `from-url.test.ts` are the output of hosted-git-info 9.0.0 on node 26.3.0 for the same 13 inputs.
- The 13 parser rows call the parser in the test process. A `beforeAll` hook runs `bun install` with the override `github:` in a child process first. An abort in the parser fails the hook, and the rows do not run. A child process that imports `bun:internal-for-testing` needs 2 s to 5 s on a debug build under load. That is too near the 5000 ms default.
- The `bun.lock` test compares each stderr line that names the lockfile. `bun install` prints `Ignoring lockfile` and continues when it cannot load `bun.lock`.
- One `bun install` covers the override values of all five providers.

**Differences from hosted-git-info 9.0.0 that this PR does not change.**

- `github:user/repo%2Egit`: the reference returns project `repo`, bun returns `repo.git`.
- `github:%`: the reference returns `undefined`, `hostedGitInfo.fromUrl` in bun throws `Invalid Git URL: InvalidURL`.
- `github:/.git`: the reference returns project `""`, bun returns `git`. `new URL("github:/.git").pathname` is `git` in bun. Open PR #39457 covers that.

</details>
